campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd01.xml.in:
Białystok

21 March 1946

Comrade General, you know how this war began. Two weeks ago, while their newspapers were still talking about peace, the British and their partners struck our forces in Germany without warning. Their plan has a name - their own staff called it Unthinkable - and in its first line are German divisions they kept under arms after the surrender and have now given back their guns.

The front in Germany has held and is already pushing them back. But the enemy prepared a second blow behind it. Armed bands of the old Home Army, supplied by air from the West, have come out of the forests around Białystok and driven our garrison out of the town and the roads around it. Every train to the front passes through here.

Take the area back quickly. Paratroopers will land to help you. The insurgent units are your target; the townspeople are not, and I want them to see the difference.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd01.xml.ou: The Białystok rising is over. Its units have been broken up, their arms dumps and radio sets are in our hands, and the trains are moving to the front again. The people of the town saw who kept order and who brought the war to their doorstep.
Białystok is ours again and the railway is open. The last insurgents have gone back into the forest without their weapons.
Białystok is ours, but it cost us far more than it should have. Remember that every man lost here is a man the front in Germany did not get.
The insurgents still hold part of the area, and the trains are being stopped. There is nobody to replace you, so you will go on to Germany with what you have. Do better there.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd02.xml.in:
The Road to Berlin

16 February 1947

Comrade General, the enemy's offensive is spent. Last spring they reached the Oder; this winter they are falling back, and the Stavka has ordered the counteroffensive that will take Berlin back from them. They seized the city in the first days of the war and have ringed it with defences since.

The approach through the Seelow Heights is held only by their lighter units. That is your chance. Break through, drive to the eastern edge of Berlin, and give your army its first taste of deep mobile operations.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd02.xml.ou: Berlin lies open. The enemy's outer ring has broken, and their German divisions are falling back into the city in disorder.
You have reached the eastern edge of Berlin. The assault on the city itself can begin.
You reached Berlin, but only just, and at a heavy price. The city itself will not be easier.
We have not even broken through the outer ring around Berlin, and the losses are terrible. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd03.xml.in:
The Siege of Berlin

28 March 1947

Comrade General, Berlin is in front of you, and you have been chosen to lead the assault.

The German divisions of the coalition are well dug in, and a British corps has been sent into the city to stiffen them. Our 5th Division will attack alongside you. Take Berlin, and the coalition loses the one prize it gained in this war.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd03.xml.ou: Berlin is ours, and quickly. The German divisions that held it have laid down their arms. Moscow is already calling you east: the same powers that planned the attack in Europe have armed Chiang Kai-shek, and his troops have crossed our border in Siberia.

Berlin is ours, and the German corps that held it has been destroyed. The road west is open, but first the enemy's southern flank must be dealt with. The British are using the ports of southern Italy as bases, and your army is going there.
Berlin is ours, but slowly, and at a price the whole army is talking about. You will go south, to Greece, where the British are moving north against Bulgaria.
The assault on Berlin has failed. The coalition holds the city, and the war will go on for years longer because of it. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd04a.xml.i:
Border Clash at Ulan-Ude

19 November 1947

Comrade General, you are needed in the East. Chiang Kai-shek has joined the war on the side of the coalition, and his armies have crossed our border and pushed deep into the Buryat Republic. They are now outside Ulan-Ude.

Throw them back across the frontier and retake every town they hold.

Do not underestimate them. They are weakened by twenty years of war at home, but they carry the same American equipment as the armies in Europe, and they may counterattack.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd04a.xml.o: The invaders have been thrown back across the frontier with heavy losses. The Chinese command is moving its reserves to the Kazakh front, and that is where you will meet them next.
Ulan-Ude is safe, and the enemy has been driven off our soil in Buryatia.
The enemy is back across the frontier, but he very nearly stopped you. The next front will not give you so much time.
The Chinese armies are across the border in strength and moving deeper into Siberia. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd05a.xml.i:
The Liberation of Alma-Ata

7 May 1948

The fighting on the Kazakh front has gone on for five months. Last week the Chinese Nationalists took Alma-Ata from our garrison.

Your corps is north of the city. Liberate it and drive the enemy out of the area, and the faster you do it, the better.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd05a.xml.o: Alma-Ata is free and the Chinese armies are routed. Chiang's government has asked for an armistice, and the People's Liberation Army is marching on Nanking. You have earned a rest - but not for long. The enemy is still in the Low Countries.
Alma-Ata is free and the Nationalist armies are retreating on every front. The People's Liberation Army is advancing, and Chiang's war against us is over. You are needed in the west.
Alma-Ata is free, though at a high price. The Nationalists have been pushed back, and you are being sent west.
Alma-Ata is still in enemy hands. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd04b.xml.i:
Beachhead at Taranto

4 August 1947

Comrade General, the coalition is using the ports of southern Italy as its base on our southern flank: its bombers fly from there, and its convoys unload there. The Italian government allowed it. The landing will be at Taranto.

Your forces will land against strong British resistance. Their ships are the greatest danger to the invasion fleet, so a flotilla of our submarines has been placed under your command to deal with them.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd04b.xml.o: The Taranto beachhead is secure, and the British have learned what a well-planned landing looks like. The port is ours.
Taranto is ours, and the British are falling back up the coast.
The British nearly pushed you back into the sea. We hold the beachhead, but the next battle must not cost as much.
The landing at Taranto has failed, and what is left of your troops has been taken off by sea. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd05b.xml.i:
Advance on Salerno

25 April 1948

The fighting in Italy goes on, but the Italian government is close to leaving the war. It has no wish to see its country become a battlefield for the British.

End it. Destroy the last large British, French and German force in southern Italy, at Salerno. More of our submarines are on their way in case their surface ships return.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd05b.xml.o: Italy has left the war, and its new government has ordered every coalition soldier off Italian soil. The Mediterranean flank is closed, and your army is going north, to the Low Countries.
Italy has left the war and demanded that the coalition withdraw its troops. The southern flank is safe.
Italy has left the war, but the victory at Salerno was too narrow to make the British leave: they are still in the north of the country. Your army is needed in the Low Countries.
The British still hold Salerno, and Italy is still in the war. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd04c.xml.i:
Thermopylae

13 October 1947

Comrade General, you are going to Greece. In the spring a British expeditionary corps, Greek royalist troops and a Turkish corps moved north against Bulgaria. They have been stopped, and now they are falling back on Thermopylae to hold the pass while their ships take them off.

They think they can do here what the Spartans once did against the Persians. Destroy them and take the pass. Watch the coast: our intelligence expects their navy to shell the coast road.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd04c.xml.o: The coalition force at Thermopylae has been destroyed. Turkey has withdrawn its troops and refuses to fight on, and the only British foothold left in Greece is Crete.
The pass is ours, and the British are evacuating to Crete.
The pass is ours, but too many of them got onto the ships. They will be waiting on Crete.
The coalition has held the pass and got its troops away. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd05c.xml.i:
Landing at Maleme

30 January 1948

Comrade General, Crete is the last coalition stronghold in the Aegean. From its airfields their bombers reach our shipping all the way to the Dardanelles. Your forces will land near Maleme; paratroopers have already come down west of your landing zone.

The Royal Navy has a strong squadron here. Our submarines have been placed under your command to deal with it.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd05c.xml.o: Crete is ours, and much of the Royal Navy's squadron is at the bottom of the sea. The Aegean is closed to the coalition.
Crete is ours, and the British squadron has been driven off. Our shipping can move again.
Crete is ours, but the cost in men and ships was heavy.
Crete remains in British hands, and their bombers will go on striking our shipping. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd06.xml.in:
Drive on Antwerp

7 September 1948

Comrade General, our offensive has reached the Low Countries. Holland fell quickly, but the enemy has built strong defences around Antwerp: it is the port through which Britain supplies its armies on the continent.

Your veteran army has been given the task of taking it. Take the city and its port, and the coalition's supply line across the sea is cut.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd06.xml.ou: Antwerp is ours. Without its port, the coalition armies in Belgium are on short rations.
Antwerp is ours, and Belgium cannot be held against us much longer.
Antwerp is ours, but at a price the Front can ill afford.
The assault on Antwerp has failed. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd07.xml.in:
Frostbite in the Ardennes

11 February 1949

The enemy has laid a trap in the Ardennes, and our troops are stuck in the forest. The general who led them in did not bring them out.

Your task is to do what he could not: break out of the forest into the open country of France, and drive the enemy back with everything you have.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd07.xml.ou: Our troops are out of the forest, and the enemy has lost the army that set the trap. The road to the Channel is open, and you have been chosen to lead the drive.
The trap has been broken, and our armies are pouring into France. The drive to the Channel is yours.
We are out of the forest, though the frost and the enemy's guns made it a hard road.
The breakout has failed, and the enemy is pushing us back into Belgium. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd08.xml.in:
Push to Dunkirk

7 June 1949

The coalition armies in France are finished, and they know it. What is left of the French army, with British and German units, is trying to get away by sea at Dunkirk.

Do not let them. Every division that escapes will be waiting for us across the Channel. Complete the operation as fast as you can.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd08.xml.ou: You have destroyed them before the ships could take them off. The Stavka is already planning the crossing of the Channel, and with the speed you have shown, the war may end years sooner.
The French army has been destroyed, and France is out of the war. But the remnants have fled south, into Spain, and Franco has opened his frontier to them.
France is out of the war, but the British got most of their troops away. The French remnants have fled into Spain, where Franco has given them shelter.
The coalition got its armies away by sea, and they will be waiting for us in England. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd09a.xml.i:
Storming Dover

13 December 1951

Comrade General, the time has come. Two years have passed since the coalition's armies fled the continent, and in all that time London has refused every offer of peace. The war that Britain started will end in Britain.

Your army has been chosen to land on the English coast and take the beaches at Dover. The British outnumber us almost two to one, but most of their troops are new recruits; the French and German units with them are more experienced but far fewer.

Our submarines will deal with the British ships in the area. Task Force Bear is landing west of you to take one of the coastal airfields.

A veteran British force is said to be on its way to the coast. Secure Dover before it arrives.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd09a.xml.o: The Dover coast is ours, and our troops are coming ashore by the thousand. For the first time in centuries the Channel has not protected England.
We have a firm foothold in England, and our men are streaming ashore.
We hold the Dover coast, but it came close to disaster and we lost many men. The next battle will decide the war.
The landing has been thrown back into the sea, and a chance like this may not come again. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd10a.xml.i:
London

12 March 1952

Comrade General, this is the last battle. London is in front of you.

It will not be easy. The coalition has pulled what is left of its armies into the city, and our intelligence reports veteran German and French units among the British defenders.

Take London, and the war the coalition began in 1946 is over.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd10a.xml.o:
The Second Great War

(From The Second Great War, 1946-1952, a history of the conflict.)

The war began in March 1946 with the Western coalition's attack on the Soviet forces in Germany, and it ended in London six years later. The Red Army that had been meant to collapse in a matter of weeks stopped the attack on the Oder, retook Berlin, beat back Chiang Kai-shek's invasion in the East, and carried the war to the Channel and across it.

The peace signed in London dissolved the coalition. Across the continent, governments that had joined the attack gave way to new ones that would not; the United States, which had stayed out of the war, recognised the settlement within a year.

The general who took London was called to Moscow, and after Stalin's death he became the head of the Soviet government.

campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd09b.xml.i:
Passage to Madrid

14 February 1950

Comrade General, France is clear of the coalition. But the French armies of the south escaped over the Pyrenees, and Franco has taken them in: Spain has joined the war against us.

You have been chosen to lead the attack on Madrid. This road is the fastest way to the capital, and intelligence expects heavy resistance and attacks from several directions along it. End Franco's war.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd09b.xml.o: Madrid has fallen and Franco's regime has collapsed with it. The coalition troops in Spain have fled to Gibraltar.
Madrid is free. The Republicans are coming home from exile, and the coalition has made its last stand at Gibraltar.
Madrid is ours, but the advance was slow, and the enemy had time to fortify Gibraltar.
The road to Madrid is blocked, and Franco has time to regroup. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd10b.xml.i:
Fortress Gibraltar

25 October 1950

At Gibraltar the coalition is making its last stand on the continent. Drive them out.

They have sent their best troops to hold the fortress and are deeply dug in, and the Royal Navy patrols the strait. We have intercepted a radio message: they may try to bring reinforcements across from North Africa.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd10b.xml.o: Gibraltar is ours. The coalition has been driven off the continent, and we control the gate of the Mediterranean.
Gibraltar has fallen, the last coalition troops have left the continent, and the Royal Navy has taken a heavy blow.
Gibraltar is ours, but the losses were very heavy.
Gibraltar still holds. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd11.xml.in:
The Kharkov Rising

28 June 1951

Comrade General, I have grave news. For three years Western intelligence has been dropping weapons, money and instructors to the nationalist bands in the Ukraine. Now they have made their move: armed formations, joined by deserters, have seized the country around Kharkov.

Defeat them. They are far less experienced than your men, but they have the same weapons as you, stolen from our depots, so be prepared for anything. The people of Kharkov are not the enemy; the armed formations are.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd11.xml.ou: The armed formations around Kharkov have been destroyed and the rest have surrendered. Order has been restored, and the preparations for the landing in England can go on.
The rising is over. The last armed groups are being rounded up, and we can return to our preparations for the invasion of England.
The main force of the rising has been beaten, but some of it got away into the countryside, and it will be some time before the area is quiet. We will call you when you are needed.
The rising still holds Kharkov, and the invasion of England has been put off. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd12.xml.in:
Storming Dover

13 December 1953

Comrade General, the time has come. More than three years have passed since the coalition's armies fled the continent, and in all that time London has refused every offer of peace. The war that Britain started will end in Britain.

Your army has been chosen to land on the English coast and take the beaches at Dover. The British outnumber us almost two to one, but most of their troops are new recruits; the French and German units with them are more experienced but far fewer.

Our submarines will deal with the British ships in the area. Task Force Bear is landing west of you to take one of the coastal airfields.

A veteran British force is said to be on its way to the coast. Secure Dover before it arrives.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd12.xml.ou: The Dover coast is ours, and our troops are coming ashore by the thousand. For the first time in centuries the Channel has not protected England.
We have a firm foothold in England, and our men are streaming ashore.
We hold the Dover coast, but it came close to disaster and we lost many men. The next battle will decide the war.
The landing has been thrown back into the sea, and a chance like this may not come again. You are relieved of command.
campaign.reddestiny.scenario.rd13.xml.in:
London

12 March 1954

Comrade General, this is the last battle. London is in front of you.

It will not be easy. The coalition has pulled what is left of its armies into the city, and our intelligence reports veteran German and French units among the British defenders.

Take London, and the war the coalition began in 1946 is over.
